QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_36

question.text: At the end of a community-development programme, the SIA assesses sustainability. The MOST critical question to address is:

answer.text: Whether the CEO is happy with the programme
Whether community interventions sustain after exit of the funding agency and whether the institutions can manage the activities after project completion
Whether the marketing material was glossy
Whether the donor received a thank-you letter

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook frames sustainability as whether benefits and community interventions continue after the funding agency's exit and whether institutions can manage activities after project completion. An exit strategy and post-funding capacity are central to the sustainability question. The Trap: CEO satisfaction, marketing aesthetics and donor courtesies are peripheral PR considerations, not sustainability evidence. Note: Document the exit strategy and post-funding capacity assessment in the report to support the sustainability conclusion.
